### Chaco and Mossy Oak Bring Iconic Bottomland Camo to a Limited-Edition Footwear Collection


September 14, 2026


The collection features adult and kids’ Z/Sandals, plus the Canyon Leather Clog and Ramble Rugged Clog for adults


ROCKFORD, Mich., Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Chaco](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0Dy0KjNtGj5AMNCR8fdytDOXHkuXlVYunIk9x-Sr_4VvVDpYbbges2W2OFBFSLx0ShmOivhAEqPJfYJSDFvAR4YFDOYeFsVtOaTkpsGET88=) , leading outdoor footwear brand, has teamed up with Mossy Oak, heritage camo brand, to release a limited-edition footwear collection featuring Bottomland, one of the most recognizable patterns in outdoor culture. Launching Sept. 14 at[Chacos.com,](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0Dy0KjNtGj5AMNCR8fdytE3Mo5DhSiuiEesF6fY7EUiAlAh5HkXqXQzKdhUVSLZkve2G_PAIYQpmsB0j3yIkHxWBwkLpjhssjJvTYGXZ33U=) the collection brings together two outdoor originals and a shared belief that a meaningful life is lived closer to the outdoors.


Both brands have spent decades helping people connect with the places they love, build traditions and make memories outdoors. The collection brings that shared heritage to footwear designed for every side of outdoor life, from trails and campgrounds to backyards, bonfires and everyday adventures.


The collection includes the adult and kids Z/Sandal, as well as Canyon Clog Leather and the Ramble Rugged Clog for adults, all featuring Mossy Oak’s original Bottomland pattern. The Z/Sandal and Canyon Clog Leather pair Chaco's podiatrist-accepted LUVSEAT™ footbed with ChacoGrip outsoles, while the Ramble Rugged Clog offers a warmer, easy-wearing option for cooler days around camp, in the backyard or wherever the day leads. Chaco’s Z/Sandals can also be repaired at the brand's Michigan-based ReChaco factory.


Created by Mossy Oak founder Toxey Haas using the natural textures and tones of dirt, leaves, sticks and bark, Bottomland was designed to reflect the outdoors as it truly is. The pattern has since become an icon of outdoor heritage and a symbol of connection to the places we love.


“Chaco and Mossy Oak are two iconic outdoor brands rooted in authenticity, heritage and a real love for the outdoors,” says Rose Fulbright, Marketing Director at Chaco. “This collection is for the people and families who have grown up with these brands, made memories outside in them and continue to carry that nostalgia into new adventures.”


“From childhood to adulthood, I’ve spent a lot of days barefoot. When I’m not, Chaco is the next best thing,” says Daniel Haas, Director of Marketing at Mossy Oak. “They’ve been the standard in outdoor sandals for decades, and Bottomland born from dirt, sticks and leaves is a natural fit.”


The Chaco x Mossy Oak limited-edition collection will be available beginning Sept. 14, 2026 at[Chacos.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0Dy0KjNtGj5AMNCR8fdytI_F1ET5QZ4kMVpgQNSCs9N_uY8BlA3kQTRHt_7ATw7t8BWzq8bnwAyiuNy8IJ6SBo8HASV3un8BwwGsqYlgtJA=) , while supplies last, with MSRPs of $70 for the Kids Z/Sandal, $155 for the Canyon Clog Leather, $95 for the Ramble Rugged Clog and $115 for the Mega Z/Sandal.


###


About Chaco


Born on the river in 1989, Chaco, a division of Wolverine Worldwide, Inc. (NYSE: WWW), builds premium footwear for the outdoor-minded. The brand's iconic Z/sandals are repairable at ReChaco and more than 20,000 sandals a year are kept out of landfills every year. Plus, as a result of the brand's proprietary LUVSEAT™ foot bed, the American Podiatric Medical Association (APMA) has awarded the Seal of Acceptance to all Chaco footwear styles. The APMA Seal is intended to raise awareness by identifying products of exceptional quality that are manufactured with comfort, health, and safety in mind. Simply put, Chaco is fit for adventure. Please visit us at[www.chacos.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Rn9YtgaDeSwxRh_oIFtinZDBGH3gI81U8tlxj8QhPYHxkLYTpd57fzGLB5uY-z39WwBJ7Liye7nJeyNcjos5YVBshAE5clyYn6uDPG-1zCc=) , Facebook: Chaco, Instagram: ChacoFootwear, TikTok: ChacoFootwear.
